# Kaggwe Marvin Victor

> Kaggwe Marvin Victor is a full-stack developer based in Kampala, Uganda. He builds web and desktop apps with Python, Django and TypeScript, and is a final-year Bachelor of Business Computing student at Makerere University Business School (CGPA 3.95/5.0, graduating February 2027).

## Key facts

- Name: Kaggwe Marvin Victor (also written Marvin Kaggwe)
- Role: Full-Stack Developer
- Location: Kampala, Uganda
- Education: Bachelor of Business Computing, Makerere University Business School (MUBS), 2020 to February 2027, Second Class Upper, CGPA 3.95/5.0
- Current work: Digital Business Manager at Florida Guest House, Kireka (2020 to present); Sales and Technical Support Associate at Della Electronics (June 2024 to present)
- Past work: Data Entry Operator (seasonal) at the Uganda National Examinations Board (2022 to 2025); Records Clerk at MMK Construction Ltd, Namanve (2023)
- Main skills: Python, Django, Django REST Framework, TypeScript, JavaScript, SQL, PostgreSQL, GitHub Actions, MikroTik RouterOS, IT support
- Open to: junior developer, business systems and IT roles, in Kampala or remote
- Contact: kaggwemarvin@gmail.com
- GitHub: https://github.com/kaggwe-marvin

## Blog posts

- [Why I built Voucher Manager: printing hotspot vouchers on RouterOS 7](https://kaggwe-marvin.github.io/Personal-Resume/blog/voucher-manager-routeros-7/): the five manual steps RouterOS 7 User Manager needs to make printable vouchers, and how Voucher Manager automates them
- [Run Linux on Windows 10 or Tiny10 with MSYS2 and QEMU](https://kaggwe-marvin.github.io/Personal-Resume/blog/msys2-qemu-linux-setup/): step-by-step guide to an Ubuntu Server VM on Windows without WSL
- [How I built my first site: from Hugo to Zola](https://kaggwe-marvin.github.io/Personal-Resume/blog/how-i-built-this-site/): lessons from building and rebuilding a personal site

## Software

- [Voucher Manager](https://github.com/kaggwe-marvin/Voucher-Manager): free Windows app that batch-creates MikroTik User Manager hotspot vouchers through the RouterOS API and prints them as PDF. Download: https://kaggwe-marvin.github.io/Personal-Resume/downloads/
- [Custom ERP](https://github.com/kaggwe-marvin/custom-ERP): Django ERP with a double-entry ledger, role-based access control and audit logging
- [Student Clearance System](https://github.com/kaggwe-marvin/student-clearance-system): role-based university clearance workflow in TypeScript, Hono and Drizzle ORM
- [Inventory Tracker](https://github.com/kaggwe-marvin/Django-Inventory-tracker): Django stock tracker with low-stock alerts and a rate-limited REST API
- [Florida Guest House booking app](https://github.com/kaggwe-marvin/florida-booking): room and spa booking with MTN MoMo and Airtel Money payments
